data.body_html:
Thinking about a Marbella boat rental weather November 2028 guide? November in Marbella brings mild air temperatures averaging 13°C to 19°C, sea temperatures of 18°C, and about 6 hours of daily sunshine. While it's cooler than summer, the sea is often calm (Beaufort 2–3), making it a solid month for a winter charter. This guide covers what to expect, which boats work best, and how to make the most of a November trip from Puerto Banús.

November Weather in Marbella: Key Numbers

November sits between autumn and winter. Average highs reach 19°C, lows drop to 13°C. Sea temperature holds at 18°C, which is cool but swimmable with a wetsuit. Rainfall averages 80mm over about 6 days, typically as short showers. Wind speed averages 12 km/h, so the sea state is mostly calm. UV index is low (2). Sunrise around 07:45, sunset at 18:15 (CET). For comparison, summer sea temps are 24°C–26°C, so November is noticeably cooler but still pleasant for a sheltered cruise.

Best Boats for November Charters

For cooler weather, boats with enclosed cabins or flybridges offer comfort. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) has a heated saloon and protected helm. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) is a superyacht with full indoor/outdoor space. For smaller groups, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) has a cabin and is budget-friendly at €749 for 2 hours. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Typical November Day on the Water

A typical November charter might start at 11:00 from Puerto Banús. Head east along the coast towards Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where sheltered coves offer calm anchorages. The sea temperature of 18°C means a short swim is possible with a wetsuit. Lunch at a beach club like Marbella Club or Puente Romano is popular. Return by 16:00 to avoid the cooler evening breeze. Sunset at 18:15 gives you time for a golden-hour cruise back to port.

What to Bring for a November Boat Trip

Pack layers: a thermal base, fleece or jumper, and a windproof jacket. Long trousers and non-slip shoes. Sunglasses and a hat for the low sun. A light rain jacket in case of showers. The boat provides blankets, drinks, and snacks. If you plan to swim, bring a 3mm wetsuit. The skipper will have safety equipment and insurance covered.

November Events and Local Highlights

November is low season, so marinas are quieter. The Marbella International Film Festival often runs in early November. Puerto Banús still has its luxury shops and restaurants open. The La Concha mountain views are crisp and clear after rain. Nearby Estepona and Sotogrande are also worth a visit by boat. The Golden Mile is less crowded, making for a relaxed coastal cruise.

Booking Tips for November 2028

Book in advance to secure your preferred boat. November is low season, so availability is better than summer, but weekends fill quickly. All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. For pricing on boats not in our Tier A or B ranges, contact us via WhatsApp. Check our Marbella boat rental hub for the full fleet and latest availability.
